activation: Server configuration only; this implementation subtask did not enable or send any real paid sample
mcp_policy: Reject before tool invocation; when campaign is known to the Python process, reject before MCP connection. Server also rejects map_protocol=mcp before incrementing counters

durable_authority.id_changes: A durable singleton binding rejects another FINAL_RUN_ID instead of granting a fresh budget
durable_authority.old_ledgers: Existing counters are imported for the exact ID without resetting. If old model calls lack token evidence, the new token allowance is conservatively exhausted
durable_authority.failure_policy: Reservations and slots are monotonic; failed or uncertain sends do not refund them

sample_grouping.authority: Business-service configuration and persistent immutable registry, never request-body fields
sample_grouping.fingerprint_source: Canonical root trip_task fingerprint resolved by Java; resume ancestry reuses its root slot
sample_grouping.duplicates: The same registered fingerprint cannot claim a second root task; new input cannot claim an unregistered sample slot
sample_grouping.phase_gate: FINAL_RUN_PHASE must match the persisted sample group; changing a client body cannot move a sample into holdout

token_reservation.model: Actual serialized HTTP request UTF-8 bytes + 4096 overhead + declared max output tokens multiplied by n
token_reservation.embedding: Actual batch serialized UTF-8 bytes + 4096 overhead
token_reservation.unbounded_campaign_request: Fail closed before transport; if only Java knows the campaign it rejects a missing token bound
token_reservation.ordinary_daily_compatibility: Legacy unbounded requests outside acceptance keep their old call-counter path, with no claimed token bound
token_reservation.billing_boundary: Conservative pre-send accounting, not provider billed usage or a currency guarantee

validation.java: CampaignBudgetIntegrationTest added for one fresh isolated DB and handed to root for serial Maven; pending execution at this handoff
validation.java_test_database: tripopt_campaign must be freshly created by root; do not clean or reset an older budget table
